deviations: UGX converted to US dollars at a constant 3700 UGX/USD; no exchange rate is given in the data or the paper.
Own/family labor valued at an hourly wage derived from the data: median positive daily hired-labor wage (5000 UGX) divided by the median reported hours per working day (6), i.e. 833 UGX/hour.

Family labor hours are only collected in seasons 5-7, so Table 6 col 8 uses seasons 5-7 and the household's pretreatment monetary profit as the lagged control (no pretreatment value of profit incl. own hours exists).

ANCOVA lagged outcome = household mean of the outcome over baseline seasons 1-3 (as available); missing pretreatment values set to 0 with a missing indicator (the indicator was collinear/dropped in all specs).
Harvest value = revenue from recorded sales (seller_data) + unsold harvest valued at the village-season median price; household price = quantity-weighted average sale price.

Monetary expenses = sum of seed, fertilizer, booster, manure, chemical, equipment, hired-labor (plot-level), harvest, decobbing, drying, storage, post-harvest labor and other post-harvest costs, plus transport costs.
notes: Returns-to-quality: bags = all bags weighed in the add4 visit (644); visual defects = count of 10 types (dirty, cobs, stones, dust, broken, immature, insect/vermin damage, rotten, insects live or dead, mould), missing answers treated as not detected. Lab defects = (foreign + inorganic + broken + pest-damaged + rotten + discoloured + immature grams)/sample weight. Sales: roster slot 1 in add5 is the research team's purchase of the random lab bag (bag weight equals the enumerator weight exactly), so market sales are slots 2-4 (116 sales from 94 households, matching the paper's 94 households). Deduction = 100*(y-z)/y with y = enumerator weight of the bags sold (matched by bag number) and z = buyer weight after deduction; net price = price*z/y. Village and ISO-week-of-sale FE, household-clustered SE (robust for col 2); singleton FE observations kept (fixef.rm='none', as in Stata reg/areg). Market access: panel_g1 follow-up seasons 4-7, ANCOVA with season FE and pretreatment outcome, village-clustered SE. Attempts 1-4 were exploratory (variable listings, survey instruments); attempt 5 was the first estimation run and differed from the final only in fixest dropping one singleton FE observation in cols 3-5 (N 115 vs 116; coefficients identical).
